finding: The deployment admission decision must execute in the same process boundary immediately before spawning the deployment command; otherwise callers can bypass a standalone evaluator.

behavior: Reads canonical current-state and changed-path evidence.
Evaluates the existing fail-closed admission policy.
Never spawns the deployment command after a denial.
Requires an explicit command delimiter and command.
Uses shell=false and propagates the child exit code.
Emits admission and invocation records linked by the admission evidence digest.
implementation.claim_boundary: This proves local enforcement and command-spawn behavior under tests. It does not prove Vercel capacity, provider skip behavior, deployment success, immutable served commit identity, or physical audio audibility.

verification.environment: isolated Node.js runtime with fetched evaluator source
cases: operations-only admission invokes exactly one command
exact-commit application invocation requires available capacity

rollback_route: Revert the additive evidence, queue-update, test, and invocation commits in reverse order. No application or provider state was mutated.
registry_change: None; the existing Reliability Engineer, Test Harness Engineer, Deployment Verifier, and Rollback Engineer roles cover this slice.
